newsitem.title: LEBANON: Lebanon's Hariri to continue policies unchanged.
newsitem.headline: Lebanon's Hariri to continue policies unchanged.

text.p: Lebanon's Prime Minister Rafik al-Hariri told parliament in a policy statement on Tuesday the new government would continue his economic and financial policies unchanged.
"Maintaining economic, financial and social stability will remain of special importance," Hariri said.
"The government's policy will remain unchanged in carrying out development projects, accelerating growth and increasing state revenues in order to strengthen the monetary and financial situation."
Hariri added: "Any additional spending should follow measures aimed at increasing revenues by the same amount. The government will try to attract Lebanese capital both inside Lebanon and abroad."
Hariri said the new goverment's top priority would be to improve social conditions.
Parliament will debate the policy statement next week before holding a vote of confidence on it.
